nodes.name: doctor_operations.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests for the doctor-operations Edge Function, covering session open/close, consultation start/complete, return-to-waiting, absent, recall and emergency patient flows against the real local Supabase stack.

nodes.name: local_stack.test.ts
nodes.summary: Smoke test that bootstraps the local Supabase stack via Docker status check and creates a service-role Supabase client used by other integration tests.

nodes.name: queue_operations.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests for queue-control actions (pause, resume, recall, skip, restore, mark absent) and alert-threshold emission, against the real local stack.

nodes.name: queue_runtime.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests for queue runtime RPCs (claim, complete, skip, restore, recall, doctor delay, mark absent) with token-engine assertions on session state and queue runtime events.

nodes.name: refund_sync.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration test for refund synchronization: seeds a captured payment order and exercises the process-refund Edge Function to verify ledger and booking state updates.

nodes.name: usage_retention.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests verifying subscription usage counters (bookings, doctors, receptionists) and retention/cleanup job behavior against the real local stack.

nodes.name: whatsapp_conversational.test.ts
nodes.summary: End-to-end integration tests for the WhatsApp conversational engine, driving inbound messages through the full booking, reschedule, cancel, queue-lookup and handoff flows and verifying outgoing job_queue entries and booking state.

nodes.name: whatsapp_lifecycle.test.ts
nodes.summary: Integration tests covering the WhatsApp message lifecycle: enqueue via RPC, delivery, retry, and read state on whatsapp_messages table.
